title: Hannah's Song and Samuel's Growth
description: Hannah praises the Lord in a deep prayer after she has received her son Samuel. The boy remains in Shiloh and serves the Lord under the priest Eli, wearing a linen ephod. Eli blesses Elkanah and Hannah, and the Lord gives her three more sons and two daughters. Samuel grows up with the Lord and is pleasing to both God and people. [ref:1 Sam 2:1-11|1. Samuel 2:1-11] [ref:1 Sam 2:18-21|1. Samuel 2:18-21] [ref:1 Sam 2:26|1. Samuel 2:26]
